name: videl-music-worker
description: Dedicated Videl clone worker for the Music profile; reconciles active clones from the shared registry.

API_ID.description: Same Telegram API ID configured for Videl

API_HASH.description: Same Telegram API hash configured for Videl

MONGO_URI.description: Same MongoDB URI/database used by Videl clone registry

ENCRYPTION_KEY.description: Same Fernet key Videl uses to decrypt clone tokens and assistant sessions

CLONE_PROFILES_SINGLE_INSTANCE.description: Must be true only when clone worker deployment is configured as a single instance

MUSIC_CLONE_WORKER.description: Fail-closed operator acknowledgement for the single Music worker process
